title: pm: check-owed-reviews and the H43 patrol read verdicts from any author and the first match, unlike the queue guard
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (a follow-up owed by work in flight: the at-tier contract review 6890532571 on PR #33687, card #33541, found this outside its diff, by reading).

After PR #33687 the queue guard reads a Tier S record only from `FLEET_BOT_LOGIN` or `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` and only on exactly one `VERDICT:` line. `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` and the H43 patrol in `check-half-states.mjs` still read every author and take the first verdict match (`contractReviewVerdictOf`). They can show a PR as reviewed, or as PASS, where the guard now refuses it. This affects display and patrol only; the guard decides the landing.

## What lands

Both readers take the guard's author binding and the guard's one-line verdict reading (one reader, imported, not copied), with a self-test row each for an untrusted author's PASS and a two-line record.

Wait for PR #33687 to merge (same files). Display only, so p3 by the seat's reading; triage grades.
